info.title: LMJ Health Backend API
info.summary: Role-sensitive healthcare API for LMJ Health mobile and web clients.
info.description: Machine-readable OpenAPI contract for the LMJ Health backend. The API is mounted under /api and uses localized JSON success/error envelopes from src/app.js. Successful JSON responses return storage-key shaped profile `photoUrl` values as short-lived signed download URLs, with the original object key in `photoKey` and the TTL in `photoUrlExpiresIn`.

get.description:
List

Requires a bearer access token.

Allowed roles: patient, doctor, admin.

Additional account-state, ownership, assignment, or delegated-access guards may apply before the controller runs.

Admin responses expose flattened doctor and patient summaries. Those admin-only summaries include fullName, email, phone, photoUrl, and role-specific identifiers; patient and doctor callers do not receive those contact fields.

Validation: query: status, doctorId, patientId, from, to, page, limit.

Source route file: src/routes/accessRequest.js.

View Appointments

Requires a bearer access token.

Allowed roles: admin, doctor, secretary, patient.

Additional account-state, ownership, assignment, or delegated-access guards may apply before the controller runs.

Doctors see appointments scoped by Appointment.doctor, so patient-booked appointments are visible to the assigned doctor after booking. Admin, doctor, and secretary list responses populate patient.userId.fullName alongside publicId for display. Response appointment objects include nullable encounter summaries as encounter. Linked encounter summaries contain only _id, status, origin, startedAt, and closedAt; encounter notes are intentionally omitted.

Validation: query: page, limit, status, date, dateFrom, dateTo.

Source route file: src/routes/appointment.js.

200.description: Paged appointment list. Admin, doctor, and secretary appointment items include patient publicId and patient.userId.fullName. Each appointment includes a nullable compact encounter summary without encounter notes.
